title: Te Kairapu Pūmau o te Pono
intro: I roto i tētahi wā i taupokina e te kuware me te karakia ki ngā atua teka, ka puta he haerenga whakapono hohonu. I werohia e tēnei tangata ngā tikanga o tōna hapori, me te rapu i te Kaihanga Pono Kotahi me te whakapono pumau. Kia rite ki te hura i te tuakiri o tētahi wairua e whakaaweawe tonu ana i te miriona tāngata.
clues: I pātai ahau ki ngā mea o te rangi, i te rapu i te Ariki pono, nāna nei i hanga, nāna nei hoki i tautoko ngā mea katoa.
I whakahaua ahau kia whakarērea tōku whenua tupu, kia haere ki te whenua i manaakitia e te Atua.
I wero ahau i ngā whakapakoko o taku iwi, i te whakahē tika atu ki tō rātou koretake mā te wawahi i a rātou.
I maka ahau ki roto i te ahi e mura ana e tōku iwi, heoi i runga i te whakahau a Allah ka marino, ka marino hoki mōku.
I whakamatautauria ahau ki te whakahau kia patua taku tama matamua aroha, he whakamatautauranga o te ngohengohe mutungakore.
Nā māua ko taku tama i whakaara te turanga o te Whare Karakia tuatahi i runga i te Ao, he wāhi tapu mō ngā tāngata katoa.

arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
